svg.title: Cozy Room — selected room with the second pet bed
svg.desc: Editable pixel-art vectors traced exactly from the selected 852 by 1846 PNG. Named layers separate the wall, floor, window, curtains, shelf, books, plant, pet bed and rug. Six solid colours. All vertices use the original integer pixel grid; collinear vertices are removed. No embedded images, external assets, fonts, gradients or effects. Visible source pixels are preserved.

g.inkscape:label: 08 · Pet bed from design 2
g.desc: The selected second bed, copied without rescaling or redrawing.
